Innovation in a World of Flux

The Future Is Not a Stage for Innovation Theater
As sectors and markets converge, acting fast (with authenticity, conviction and purpose) on truly groundbreaking ideas is the only way to cut through the noise. In this session: Véronique Bruhat, Digital Health Product Manager, Sanofi; Luc Dammann, President of EMEA, Adobe; Gagandeep Gadri, Managing Director, frog.
Science-Led Business Transformation
PMI is in the middle of a massive shift toward radical transformation in its product offering, pledging to become a majority smoke-free business by 2025. In this session: a live interview with Dr. Moira Gilchrist, Vice President, Scientific & Strategic Communications, Philip Morris International, led by Gagandeep Gadri, Managing Director, frog.
The Rise of the Maker Brand in the Age of Innovation
Today's businesses must pivot to becoming active maker brands to compete on experience. But precisely how to make these necessary shifts is a matter of debate. In this session moderated by Russell Parsons, Editor of Marketing Week, hear from Gagandeep Gadri, Managing Director, frog; Jay Pattisall, Vice President & Principal Analyst, Forrester; Dustin Sedgwick, CMO Payments, JPMorgan Chase & Co.
Creative Confessions Happy Hour
Release yourself from the past. Step into the future unburdened. Grab a drink and gather your nerve. Join us in the frog Cabana to share your creative confession.

Creativity in the Machine Era

Data Wars & Future-Forward Storytelling at Scale
Paradigm shifts in brand storytelling are raising the stakes for emerging technology and human creativity alike. In this session led by Andreas Markdalen, Global Chief Creative Officer at frog, hear from Alvaro Del Pozo, Vice President, International Marketing, Adobe; Sarah Kiefer, Chief Marketing Officer, Pitch; Jay Pattisall, Vice President & Principal Analyst, Forrester.
Journeying into the Metaverse
It’s time to talk all things metaverse, immersive brand storytelling and innovation at the intersection of physical and digital worlds. In this session: a live interview with Ahmed Daoud, Executive Director of Innovation, the Royal Commission for AlUla, led by Andreas Markdalen, Global Chief Creative Officer at frog.
Meeting Consumer Expectations with Generative AI
Brands are seeking ways to experiment with generative AI. What does the research show about what consumers expect? In this session, we talk about new findings from the Capgemini Research Institute. Moderated by Candice Golend, Global Chief Marketing Officer, Capgemini Invent, this discussion features Andreas Markdalen, Global Chief Creative Officer, frog and Mark Oost, Global Offer Leader AI, Analytics & Data Science, Capgemini.
Creative Confessions Happy Hour
Release yourself from the past. Step into the future unburdened. Grab a drink and gather your nerve. Join us in the frog Cabana to share your creative confession.

Expectations of a Connected World

Driving Mobility into the Connected World
Driving strategic, creative innovation in the future of mobility will mean engaging new sources of data, leveraging next-level tech and bringing customer ecosystems together. In this session, Chiara Diana, Chief Design Officer, frog will lead a conversation with Timo Bularczyk, Global Head of IT, Mercedes-Benz Mobility and Christina Schehl, Vice President & Head of frog Germany.
Connecting the Fan Experience
With AC Milan, we’ll talk about the interconnected worlds of sports and entertainment, transforming a beloved sports organization into a multimedia powerhouse, and driving innovation for fans worldwide. In this session, Chiara Diana, Chief Design Officer, frog, interviews Pierdonato Vercellone, Chief Communication Officer, AC Milan.
Creative Solutions to Connected Challenges
There are five challenges to achieving the full potential of the evolving connected world. In this session, we discuss the impact of these challenges—and how to overcome them. In this session led by Chiara Diana, Chief Design Officer, frog, hear from Beatrice Dautzenberg, Global Director of Beauty Tech Services, L’Oréal; Ruth Thomson, Senior Vice President, Cambridge Consultants; Ximena O’Reilly, Global Head of Design, Nestlé.
Creative Confessions Happy Hour
Release yourself from the past. Step into the future unburdened. Grab a drink and gather your nerve. Join us in the frog Cabana to share your creative confession.

End of the World vs. End of the Month

Clothed in Chaos: How to Design for Hazard-Proof Living
In a hostile world, clothing is survival. frog will debut a tech-enabled sustainable fashion collaboration with MACHINA. Moderated by Kara Pecknold, Vice President, Regenerative Design at frog, this session features Oliver Lange, Head of H&Mbeyond, Todd Taylor, Executive Director of Marketing, frog and Andreas Markdalen, Global Chief Creative Officer, frog.
Unite to Act with UN SDG Action Campaign
It’s time to unite for action. In this session, get a sneak peek of the new UN SDG Action Campaign. This session will be led by Kara Pecknold, Vice President Regenerative Design, frog, and feature Marina Ponti, Director of UN SDG Action Campaign and Dr. Maike Benz, Vice President, Brand & Content, frog.
Be the Hero We Need for the Next Economy
Long-term sustainability goals can seem at odds with short-term gains. Now is the time to future-proof business strategy. Moderated by Thomas Husson, Vice President & Principal Analyst, Forrester, this session will feature Kara Pecknold, Vice President Regenerative Design, frog and Clément Chenut, Circular Economy Leader, Capgemini.
